claims.claim: A 29-inch LG TV is for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a dark glossy large kitchen appliance with a curved front edge and a vent/grille side panel—described as a refrigerator or similar large appliance, not a TV.

claims.claim: It’s the transformer that got blown up.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of a TV, transformer, or any internal component damage; the witness report does not show a TV or transformer.

claims.claim: Location: Onike, near the University of Lagos (Unilag), Lagos State.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include location confirmation (no signage, address, or geotag).

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch (seller claims TV; witness photos show a refrigerator/large kitchen appliance). Buying based on the seller’s words could lead to receiving the wrong item.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the TV (screen) showing the 29-inch size and LG branding, plus a photo of the back label/model/rating plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/unknown large appliance with uncertain working status (worst-case: not working and missing/unknown parts).

risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and operation (for a refrigerator: compressor running and temperature change; for a TV: screen turning on with a test image).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until operation is proven.

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown (dents, scratches, rust, broken seals, missing parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides and edges, especially doors/seals (if refrigerator) or ports/back panel (if TV), plus any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/structural condition (as-is with possible damage).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/interior parts (shelves/bins/crisper/ice tray for refrigerator; stand/remote/cables for TV).
risks.proof: Photos showing all included accessories and the full interior (for refrigerator) or the full set (for TV: remote, stand, power cable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (missing accessories) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Power/voltage compatibility and safety (especially if transformer claim is true for a TV).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate showing voltage and power, and a video showing safe power-up (no burning smell/sparks).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unsafe/uncertain electrical condition until verified.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the item’s front showing whether it is a TV screen (and the 29-inch size) or a refrigerator door/front.
Send a photo of the brand/model rating plate (back or side label) with readable model number and voltage.
Send a short video showing the item powering on and functioning (TV: screen with a test channel; refrigerator: compressor running and cooling).
If it is a TV: show the transformer/board area that is claimed to be blown (close-up) and confirm whether it powers on at all.
Confirm included accessories (TV: remote, stand, power cable; refrigerator: shelves/bins/crisper/ice tray).
Provide additional location confirmation (e.g., a nearby landmark photo or exact address pin).
response.reason: The seller’s claim (29-inch LG TV) is contradicted by the witness photos showing a refrigerator/large kitchen appliance, and the transformer/blown component claim cannot be verified remotely without proof of the actual item and working status.
